title: Chapter 754 Arriving At The Dark Universe!
content:
Chapter 754 Arriving At The Dark Universe!

Chapter 754  Arriving at the Dark Universe!

The next moment, Lin Fan appeared in a soft world.

He took a deep breath. The air was filled with a sweet smell.

Lin Fan looked around and realized that the trees, houses, mountains…They were all made of candy.

This... It was actually a world made of candy.

"Woo!"

At this moment, a train that looked like Thomas roared and drove over from afar.

There was also a group of short people wearing colorful clothes.

When Lin Fan saw them, they also saw Lin Fan. They stuck their heads out of the car window and started chattering.

Lin Fan could not help but smile at this.

"Whoosh!"

At this moment, a bearded man dressed in red drove a flying motorboat and stopped in front of Lin Fan.

"Respected expert, hello. Welcome to Candy Planet. I am the governor of Candy Planet, Clay."

Lin Fan nodded," Hello, my name is Lin Fan.""

This expert actually told him his name?

Klein became extremely excited and said respectfully,""Lord Lin, our Candy Planet has all kinds of candies, as well as many special scenery and games. If you are interested, I can bring you around and play."

Lin Fan nodded," Alright."

This candy planet was like a world in an anime. It was colorful and incomparably sweet.

If you wanted to eat candy, you could just open your mouth and eat all kinds of candy.

Lin Fan stayed here for half a year before leaving.

Next, he went to a world full of seawater and saw the legendary mermaids there. He went to the Flame World and saw the Earth's Core Man there. They went to the Snow World, where snow was everywhere and snowmen were everywhere. He went to the world in the sky and saw many angels with wings there.

All kinds of scenery, all kinds of customs…It caused Lin Fan's state of mind and comprehension to increase by different degrees.

The layer of membrane that had been broken through gradually became clearer and clearer.

Lin Fan had a feeling that it wouldn't be long before he could truly break through.

On this day, Lin Fan stood on a mountain peak, allowing the gentle breeze to caress his clothes.

He felt extremely relaxed and comfortable.

He looked down at the beautiful scenery for a while, then turned his attention to the system panel.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level 9 Emperor-tier]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Sacred Lord-level), Curse Technique (Sacred King-level), Sword Nurturing Technique (Sacred Lord-level), Universe Sword Technique (Sacred Lord-level)...]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Holy Lord), Flame Armor (Holy Lord), Heavenly Soul Bead (Holy Lord), True Dragon Sword (Holy Lord)...]

[Laws: Time (Intermediate), Space (Advanced), Metal (Advanced), Wood (Advanced), Water (Advanced), Fire (Advanced), Earth (Advanced), Life (Advanced), Death (Advanced), Yin (Advanced), Yang (Advanced), Wind (Advanced)…]

[Character Relationship:

Lin Tao, Daddy, Favorability: 10 stars;

[Dai Weixue: Mom, favorability rating of 10 stars.]

Lin Xiaoyao, Sister, Favorability: 10 stars;

Xia Xue: Dao Companion, Favorability 10 stars;

[Xia Bing: Dao Companion, Favorability: 10 stars…]

Lin Fan had over ten types of Holy Lord skills and over ten pieces of Holy Lord equipment…If a Holy Lord level expert knew about this, they would definitely be extremely jealous.

That was because even a Sacred Lord expert would only have one or two Sacred Lord level items.

Lin Fan's wealth had already far surpassed that of the Holy Master.

However, Lin Fan didn't care about these riches at all.

He immediately turned his attention to Lin Chengzhen.

That was because Lin Fan realized that Lin Chengzhen's name had turned into a flickering greyish-white color.

Something had happened to him!

Lin Fan frowned.

He remembered that Lin Chengzhen once said that in the dark universe.

And so, Lin Fan took a step forward and instantly arrived at the Interstellar Exclusive Shop.

"Welcome," a bearded man said hurriedly."What can I do for you?""

"I want the most detailed maps and spatial coordinates of the various universes."Lin Fan said.

" It's the right decision for you to come to our shop," the bearded man said." I can guarantee that no one on the entire planet has more accurate maps and coordinates than us.""

"Because we only updated these things a week ago."

Then, he took out a photon computer and said,"" This is a super intelligent optical computer. It contains the most detailed map, as well as ultra-clear 3D communication and advanced signal technology..."

Lin Fan didn't wait for him to finish his introduction and said,""Alright, then I'll take it."

"Sir, are you preparing to go to outer space?" asked the bearded man. We also have starships and all kinds of space supplies. Do you need anything?"

Lin Fan shook his head," No need."

After he paid the money, he instantly disappeared from the shop.

The bearded man's heart skipped a beat.""Farewell, sir."

Lin Fan didn't hear that.

He moved the space according to the coordinates on the photon computer.

One had to admit that Lin Fan's cultivation was really terrifying.

After dozens of teleportations, he passed through a cosmos.

"Whoosh!"

When Lin Fan teleported out once again, a dense amount of meteorites were shooting down from above his head. It was so terrifying that it made one's scalp go numb.

Once this meteorite fell, it could instantly destroy a star!

He saw…

Lin Fan waved his hand casually.

"Tsk!"

All the meteorites disappeared like bubbles.

Then, his body flashed and he moved forward again.

In the starship below the meteorite, a group of people were pale and at a loss.

After a long time, they started to discuss.

"Just now…What happened?"

"Where did the meteorite go?"

"Could this be a dream?"

"No, it's not a dream! Look at the record!"

Soon, the image of the meteorite and the tall figure that appeared below it appeared on the main display screen of the starship.

Everyone widened their eyes in disbelief.

"Waving his hand…The meteorite will be gone…"

"He... Who is it?"

"So handsome!"

....

This was just something Lin Fan did casually.

Lin Fan couldn't hear these sighs anymore.

After searching for a direction and moving around for an entire day, Lin Fan finally arrived at a dark universe.

The air was filled with a cold and disgusting aura.

Lin Fan frowned.

His son had lived in this universe for hundreds of years?

"Brat, hand over all your treasures!"A monster that was several meters tall shouted ferociously.

Lin Fan didn't even turn his head around and just casually threw it out.

"Whoosh!"

The tall monster exploded like a balloon. Blood and flesh flew everywhere.

It was ferocious and terrifying!
